newsitem.title: NORWAY: Christiania Bank names new president.
newsitem.headline: Christiania Bank names new president.

text.p: Christiania Bank og Kreditkassen said on Thursday the board of directors would put forward Tom Ruud to succeed Borger Lenth as president and chief executive officer.
The board will make the proposal to the supervisory board on November 26.
Ruud is currently President and Chief Executive Officer of Aker ASA.
Christiania said Ruud will initially become corporate vice president from mid-January 1997 and will take up the position of president and CEO during the course of the first six months of the year.
Lenth will continue to act as adviser to Ruud until his retirement at the end of the year.
